items.title: OpenAI supports California’s bill to advance youth AI safety
items.summary: OpenAI supports California SB 1119, advancing strong, age-appropriate AI safeguards for teens while preserving opportunities to learn, create, and explore.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
items.summary: OpenAI shares how its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices support responsible AI governance in Europe. The work will continue as the EU AI Act advances.

items.title: The US is advancing AI safety through state and federal action
items.summary: OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI.

items.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
items.summary: Explore GPT-Red, OpenAI’s automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.

items.title: Advancing youth safety and opportunity through global leadership
items.summary: OpenAI calls for global action on youth AI safety, proposing an international institute to strengthen safeguards, standards, and opportunities for young people.

items.title: Our views on AI policy and political advocacy
items.summary: Our approach to AI policy and political advocacy, transparency, support for thoughtful regulation and AI safety, and that no outside political group speaks on the company’s behalf.

items.title: OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework
items.summary: Explore OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework and how our AI safety, security, and risk practices align with emerging EU and California regulations.

items.title: AI fundamentals
items.summary: Learn what AI is, how it works, and how tools like ChatGPT use large language models. A clear, beginner-friendly guide to understanding artificial intelligence.

items.summary: A pilot program to support independent safety and alignment research and develop the next generation of talent

items.title: Introducing the OpenAI Safety Bug Bounty program
items.summary: OpenAI launches a Safety Bug Bounty program to identify AI abuse and safety risks, including agentic vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and data exfiltration.

items.title: How we monitor internal coding agents for misalignment
items.summary: How OpenAI uses chain-of-thought monitoring to study misalignment in internal coding agents—analyzing real-world deployments to detect risks and strengthen AI safety safeguards.

items.summary: How ChatGPT defends against prompt injection and social engineering by constraining risky actions and protecting sensitive data in agent workflows.

items.title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
items.summary: IH-Challenge trains models to prioritize trusted instructions, improving instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and resistance to prompt injection attacks.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Promptfoo
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development.

items.title: Reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, and that’s good
items.summary: OpenAI introduces CoT-Control and finds reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, reinforcing monitorability as an AI safety safeguard.

items.title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
items.summary: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations defend against prompt injection and AI-driven data exfiltration.

items.title: Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI protects user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection with built-in safeguards.

items.title: Continuously hardening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection attacks using automated red teaming trained with reinforcement learning. This proactive discover-and-patch loop helps identify novel exploits early and harden the browser agent’s defenses as AI becomes more agentic.

items.title: Understanding prompt injections: a frontier security challenge
items.summary: Prompt injections are a frontier security challenge for AI systems. Learn how these attacks work and how OpenAI is advancing research, training models, and building safeguards for users.

items.title: Addendum to GPT-5 System Card: Sensitive conversations
items.summary: This system card details GPT-5’s improvements in handling sensitive conversations, including new benchmarks for emotional reliance, mental health, and jailbreak resistance.

items.title: OpenAI announces strategic collaboration with Japan’s Digital Agency
items.summary: OpenAI and Japan’s Digital Agency partner to advance generative AI in public services, support international AI governance, and promote safe, trustworthy AI adoption worldwide.

items.title: Working with US CAISI and UK AISI to build more secure AI systems
items.summary: OpenAI shares progress on the partnership with the US CAISI and UK AISI to strengthen AI safety and security.

items.title: A joint statement from OpenAI and Microsoft
items.summary: OpenAI and Microsoft sign a new MOU, reinforcing their partnership and shared commitment to AI safety and innovation.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a joint safety evaluation
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.

items.summary: Data residency builds on OpenAI’s enterprise-grade data privacy, security, and compliance programs supporting customers worldwide.

items.summary: Data residency builds on OpenAI’s enterprise-grade data privacy, security, and compliance programs supporting customers worldwide.

items.title: Zico Kolter Joins OpenAI’s Board of Directors
items.summary: Zico Kolter Joins OpenAI’s Board of Directors We’re strengthening our governance with expertise in AI safety and alignment. Zico will also join the Safety & Security Committee

items.title: OpenAI safety practices
items.summary: Artificial general intelligence has the potential to benefit nearly every aspect of our lives—so it must be developed and deployed responsibly.

items.title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions

items.title: Frontier Model Forum updates
items.summary: Together with Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft, we’re announcing the new Executive Director of the Frontier Model Forum and a new $10 million AI Safety Fund.

items.title: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
items.summary: We’re announcing an open call for the OpenAI Red Teaming Network and invite domain experts interested in improving the safety of OpenAI’s models to join our efforts.

items.title: Frontier Model Forum
items.summary: We’re forming a new industry body to promote the safe and responsible development of frontier AI systems: advancing AI safety research, identifying best practices and standards, and facilitating information sharing among policymakers and industry.

items.title: Moving AI governance forward
items.summary: OpenAI and other leading labs reinforce AI safety, security and trustworthiness through voluntary commitments.

items.title: Language models can explain neurons in language models
items.summary: We use GPT-4 to automatically write explanations for the behavior of neurons in large language models and to score those explanations. We release a dataset of these (imperfect) explanations and scores for every neuron in GPT-2.

items.title: Our approach to AI safety
items.summary: Ensuring that AI systems are built, deployed, and used safely is critical to our mission.

items.title: Concrete AI safety problems
